verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents an official MCP Server that gives AI assistants/agents programmatic access to the Admin API via the Model Context Protocol, and a runtime probe confirms a live hosted MCP endpoint (mcp.flagsmith.com) responding to JSON-RPC initialize calls (key-gated). This is first-party, dedicated, and independently verified as functioning. Missing for 10: no independent/community hands-on report of actually using an agent through the MCP server in a real workflow.
